questions.text:
A man with a clipboard was sizing up our house yesterday. 😤
Calder's been gone three days and he's the only one who ever deals with the landlord.
Somebody must have told him it was happening.
Who called Calder yesterday morning?

Never heard of her.
Calder knows bands, bartenders and the one guy in Virginia who still fixes tape machines. That's about it.
What does Dana do for a living?

That's the last job title I wanted to hear. 😳
Four of us live here. Bex, Idris and I each send Calder our share every month and he handles the rest.
How many people is the rent actually split between?
questions.hint: Open SplitPay and look inside the house group.

questions.text:
So he's not even in it.
Three years I've handed him money straight off a night shift without thinking twice.
Once our rent reaches him, who does he send it on to every month?

That's no landlord I ever heard of.
Calder only ever called her 'Mrs. F.' and said she hated phone calls.
What kind of business is Halloran & Pike?

Probate means somebody died. 😔
I fill in enough of that paperwork at the hospital to know.
Whose estate is this about?
questions.hint: Go through his Photos from a few weeks back.

onboarding.text: I'm Joss. I work nights on a cardiac ward, so I notice things at odd hours. Yesterday a man with a clipboard stood on our sidewalk photographing the house. Nobody told us why.
onboarding.label: Joss

onboarding.text: Calder got me into this house three years ago. He fixes the boiler, labels his leftovers and plays us rough mixes at two in the morning. He collects our rent every month. I never asked where it went.
onboarding.label: Joss & Calder

onboarding.text: Calder Finch. Sound engineer, studio in our basement, the one name on the lease. Three days ago he packed a rented van to the roof and left. One text since: away for work, rent's sorted.
onboarding.label: Calder

onboarding.text: His old phone is still charging in the kitchen drawer, synced to everything he owns. Bex and Idris think he's selling us out. I need to know before I believe it. Help me look.
onboarding.label: Joss

msgs.text: Hi, this is Wendell here from Tideline Recording in Norfolk. Got your number from Gus. Is the Trident console still available?
Hey Wendell. Yeah, still here. Gus said you might message.
Great. Can I call you this evening?
After 7 works.
Good talking. The number we agreed on the phone works for me.
Cool. I need a week to finish a couple of sessions on it first.
No rush. Still good for the drop-off? I've cleared the back room.
Van's booked. I'll load up early and drive down in a couple of days.
Loading dock is round the back on Colley Ave. Ring the bell, I'll be in from 9.
Here. Parked out back by the dock.
Coming down now ☕
Come by at nine, we'll start on the patchbay. Coffee's on me.
Payment's sent. Check your PayPal 👍
Got it. Thanks, Wendell.
Going to stay one more night and help you get the rest wired in. Don't want to leave you with a rat's nest.
You're a good man. I'll make up the spare room.
Hi Calder, Naomi Feld from Gravel Road Stories. Pine Barrens' singer gave me your number. Do you do podcast cleanup?
I do. How long are the episodes
About 40 min each, two voices, recorded over video call, some room echo
Send me one and I'll do a free ten-minute sample
That's generous. Sending a link now
Sample's in your inbox. Noise floor down, de-essed, levels evened out
Oh my god. My co-host sounds like a person instead of a tin can
Technical term
What are your rates
45 an hour of my time, a 40 min episode is usually about 2 hours. I invoice through PayPal
Fair. Can I send you six episodes
Send them. I'll turn them around in a week
Quick q: episode 3 has a siren in the background around minute 22. Fixable?
Probably. Usually I can pull it down, not out. If it's over speech I'll tell you
Episodes 1 and 2 done, links in your email
Listening now. Walking the dog and grinning at my phone
One note: ep 2 the intro music is too loud under the voice
That's baked into the file you sent me. Do you have the stems
I do! Sending
Stems sent. Sorry, should have said
Fixed, new version is up
Perfect. Invoice me for all of it so far
Sent
Paid! Check PayPal
Episode 5 has a long cough section my co-host wants cut, can you just delete the whole bit
I can. Want me to crossfade over it or leave a breath
Breath. She's dramatic
Episodes 3 to 6 are all done. Siren is down to a ghost
A ghost I can live with
Unrelated: do you know anyone selling a decent used boom arm for a mic stand
Check Old Dominion Gear Swap, there are usually a few
did you hear the Cary Street room is closing in the fall
Yeah I heard. Sad. Best room sound in town
where will anyone play now
Basements. Mine included, apparently
Can I borrow your good headphones for a weekend?
Which ones, the closed-back?
the ones round your neck in every photo
Those are my lifeline. Take the spare pair
deal, thank you
Season finale is next week. Can I book you for a bigger mastering pass? Loudness for the platforms
Yes. Most platforms want around -16 LUFS stereo. I'll hit that
I have no idea what that means but yes
Means it won't be blaring or whisper-quiet. Don't worry about it
returned them, left on your step
Got them. Thanks
Sending the finale files tonight. No rush
Got them. I'm traveling a bit but I'll have it back to you by the end of the week
No problem, take your time
Finale rough pass is up. Take a listen when you can
Crying a little at the outro. Thank you
Reminder: your reservation is coming up. Please bring a valid license and the card used to book.
Will do. Can I add a second driver?
Yes, a second driver is a small daily fee and they'll need their license in person.
No need then, just me
The damage waiver is optional. Reply if you'd like it added.
No thanks, my own policy covers it
Capital Van Hire: your reservation is confirmed. Cargo van, 7 day rental. Pickup is after 4 PM.
Fuel policy: please return with a full tank to avoid a refueling fee.
Got it
Capital Van Hire: your van is ready at the counter. Please bring your licence and card.
On my way. Can I get the moving blankets too?
Four blankets are in the back already. See you soon.
Hi, your rental is due back soon. Need to extend? Reply here.
Late returns after the due time are charged hourly.
Bins are out. Recycling is the blue one, Idris, not the one with the lid you like.
That's a fair and specific accusation.
Boiler is doing the banging thing again 😩
Bleed the radiator in the hall first. I'll call the boiler guy.
Whose turn is the bins? They're overflowing again
Bins are Calder's this week, I did them last
Yep mine. Doing it now
Thank you 🙏
Someone ate my labeled leftovers. I will find you.
Wasn't me, mine are the chili ones with tape on the lid
...it was me. I'll buy you more rice
Idris I work nights. Respect the container.
Who keeps feeding Fader twice? He's lying to all of us.
Not me. I have alibis. Several.
Fader is on the kitchen counter again, someone left the tuna out
Sorry, that's me. Putting him down
Hot water went cold mid-shower, anyone else?
Ferrell's been out already, I'll sort another time if it keeps happening
Away for work a few days. Rent's sorted.
Sorted how, exactly?
Saw you pull out. That's a lot of van for a few days.
Who's feeding Fader?
I did. Calder, answer your phone.
There's a guy outside with a clipboard taking photos of the house. Anyone expecting anyone?
Not me. Looks like a survey or something.
I'd call the landlord but we don't have a number for the landlord. Funny that.
Got a new batch of 1/4 inch reels, fresh. $22 each.
Hold two for me. Next week?
Held.
Do you still have the splicing tape?
Half a roll. $6.
Take it.
Got the two-inch reel you asked about. Heads are decent, one pinch roller is cracked.
Can you source a roller? I'll pay for postage.
Have one in the shop. Free, you old cheapskate.
Legend. Calibrate tape next time you're up?
Bring a thermos. The shop heater is dead.
Got two boxes of quarter-inch in, fresh stock, same as last time
How many reels in each
Ten per box. Metal reels, all clean
I'll take one box. Hold it and I'll swing by
Held. Cash or card
Card, I'm out of cash
Got your reel order in. Two of the 456, one splice kit
Great. Can I grab them this afternoon?
Shop's open till five
Running late, there by 4:30
No rush
Picked up the tape. Thanks for letting me dig through the old stock bin
You're the only one who actually enjoys it
Heads up, a guy asked about your old splicing block, wondering if you'd sell
Not selling, that one's my favorite
That's what I told him. Said you'd say that
Heads up, price on the splicing tape went up a couple bucks
Ugh. Hold one for me anyway
Done. Also found a box of old leader tape, want it? Free.
Absolutely yes
Ok, it's in the box under the counter
Do you know how to bake a sticky-shed tape
Low oven, a few hours, a dehydrator is gentler. Play it right after it cools
Dehydrator, got it. I have one for jerky, don't tell my wife
Machines are getting cleared out of the back room. First dibs for you.
Appreciate it. Send me a list.
Will do.
Mailed the leader tape. Tracking is in your email
Thanks
Left the leader tape behind the counter with your name on it
Thanks Gus, swing by when you're next in the neighborhood
Package got delivered to your address, signed by someone named Bex
She'll put it by the door. Thanks Gus
Dehydrator ran four hours, tape plays clean. Jerky tastes faintly of oxide
Don't eat the jerky
Hi Calder, Mina Okoye. I host a small podcast about local history. Sam recommended you for audio clean-up.
Hi Mina. Happy to take a look. How long are the episodes?
About 40 min each. Recorded on a laptop in my kitchen, so there's a fridge hum I can't get rid of.
Fridge hum I can fix. Send me one episode and I'll do a free test.
Really? Sending now.
Test file is back. Fridge hum is gone, plus I took out the mouth clicks.
OH MY GOD. I sound like a professional.
How much?
$45 per episode for clean-up and levelling. $60 if there's music beds to sort out.
Deal. I've got eight episodes in the backlog.
Episode three is posted, and listeners say it sounds clearer. A guy wrote a review saying 'finally I can hear the dates'.
Best review possible.
Invoice me for the first four?
Sent. PayPal link is on it.
Paid. Thanks!
Can you do an episode with two guests on a bad phone line? Is that a lost cause?
Not lost. Phone lines are narrow band, I can make it listenable with some EQ. Won't sound like a studio.
That's all I want.
They're two retired railway workers, and they talk over each other constantly.
I will make it sound like a dignified argument.
Railway episode is done. Did my best on the crosstalk. One of them coughs around the 22 minute mark, I left it in because it felt like part of the story.
That's Walt. He coughs on every call.
Please send the file whenever, no rush
I'm thinking of adding a theme tune. Do you know anyone who does cheap library music?
Look at free music archives with CC licenses. Check the terms carefully.
Or I can write you 20 seconds of something for $80. Ukulele and a typewriter sample.
Typewriter sample!!! Yes.
dinner at ours on July 28? Tobi's cooking jollof
Yes please. Can I bring anything
Just yourself and something to drink
Theme draft attached. Tell me what to change.
I love it. Can the typewriter be a bit louder?
Done. v2.
Perfect. Final.
Running ten minutes late, stopped for juice
ok door's open
Tobi says thanks for fixing the speaker
It was just a loose cable. Tell him not to yank it
lol I'll pass that on
Invoice for the theme + last four episodes?
$260 total. Sending.
Paid. And thanks for the speedy turnaround.
got a question: do you know anyone who repairs turntables
Yes, a guy on Hull Street. I'll text you his number
He's good and cheap. Say I sent you
legend
Next batch of three episodes uploaded to the folder. No rush, next week is fine.
Out of town for a couple days. I'll start on them when I'm back.
Totally fine. Enjoy the trip!
It's work, but thanks.
you alive? haven't seen you since the Tallow thing
Alive. Buried in mixes. You?
Work's slow. Thinking about building a pedal board.
Please don't buy the cheap ones. They hum.
That's why I'm asking the expert
Build your own. Kits are $30. I can lend you a soldering iron.
You'd lend me THE iron?
The old one. The good one stays here.
pulled the trigger on a fuzz kit. any tips for the first solder?
Heat the pad and the leg together, not the solder. Let it flow. Don't linger.
ok ok. also what does 'cold joint' mean
It's when it looks like a dull blob. Reflow it.
done. it smells like burnt hair
That's flux. Totally normal.
it works!!! it screams
Congrats. Welcome to the club.
BBQ at Tess's tonight, you coming? she's got that smoker.
Probably. I'll bring chili. I've got a vat in the freezer.
Bring chili to a BBQ. Bold.
Nobody turns down chili.
ok the chili was the hit. Tess asked for the recipe
It's beans, beans, and more beans. Tell her I'll write it down.
dude, my amp just died mid-song. just a click and silence
Fuse? Check the back panel.
...it was the fuse
Always the fuse.
I'm a genius
You're something.
game night this weekend? Dev is bringing the new one
I'm in. Do I need to read the rules
nobody reads the rules. We'll figure it out
Dev always wins anyway
want to go to the flea market tomorrow? people sell old synths
I do, but I'm not buying anything. Budget's tight.
we're just looking
That's what I said last time, and I came home with a drum machine.
found a Juno for $200 and it's... not working?
Check the power supply. If it's a dead voice chip, walk away.
walked away. proud of me?
that last round was robbery
You took the longest road, you deserved it
lunch? tacos by the river
Can't, mixing all day. Rain check
always mixing 😅
I'll bring chips next time
Bring salsa too
you around? Gus is selling a bunch of old tape machines, want me to ask about prices?
Out of town for work. Back in a few days. Ask him about the reel-to-reel and I'll call.
on it. drive safe.

Confirmed.
Tech's finished. Pressure valve replaced. Invoice will be emailed.
Thanks.
Invoice came through. Question about the warranty on the valve?
90 days on parts and labor.
Good enough.
Hi, this is Ferrell Heating. Confirming your annual service visit for next week, between 8 and 12
That works. Basement door will be unlocked, someone will be home
Great. Please clear access to the boiler
Morning, this is Ferrell Heating. We can fit you in for the annual service on July 29.
That works, mornings are best, I work from the basement
We'll aim for 9, give or take
Technician is on the way, about 20 minutes out
Thanks. Idris is home to let him in
Service complete. Pressure was a little low, topped it up. Flue clear

Watch the gauge, keep it between 1 and 2 bar. If it drops again call us
Invoice ref FHB-2291 sent to your email

Ferrell Heating: we can fit you in to look at the boiler. Morning or afternoon?
Afternoon. Anyone's home after 2.
Booked. Pressure valve is a likely culprit, parts are cheap.
Thanks. Mind the cat, he sits on the warm pipes.
On our way, ten minutes
Side gate's unlocked, boiler's in the utility closet

Should be steady. If it drops again call us right away

Sorry to hear. Could be a slow leak at the expansion vessel. Can we send someone
Yes please, as soon as possible
We have an opening on August 2, morning
Take it
Friendly reminder to bleed the radiators before autumn.
Will do.
Hot water went cold again tonight, just for a minute. Should I worry?
Probably the thermostat settling. Leave it a day or so, then ring us if it repeats
Will do
Replaced the valve. Pressure holding at 1.4. Please monitor for 48 hours
Thanks, I'll keep an eye on it
Following up, any issues with pressure since the visit
Holding steady at 1.4, thanks
Great. We'll close the ticket. Thanks for choosing Ferrell Heating & Boiler
Did you get the casserole dish back from Tamsin? She swears she left it on your porch.
Found it behind the recycling. Fader was sitting in it.
Of course he was 😂
The church summer fete is August 22. Free sound check dinner if you do the PA. I'll pay you in lemon bars.
Putting it in the calendar. Lemon bars are an acceptable rate.
Are you eating? You sounded thin on the phone.
I batch-cooked chili. It's labelled and everything.
Labelled. Good boy. You still need a vegetable though.
Quick one. Are those lawyers still bothering you?
It's handled, Lou. Don't worry about it.
I'll worry if I like.
Marguerite never trusted lawyers either, and she was your grandmother, so you come by it honestly.
I bet you still use her birthday for every password.
...not every one
Most of them.
I knew it 😂 Change at least the bank one, sweetheart.
The bank one is a word. A bad word. Very secure.
Tamsin got the vet tech promotion! I'm telling everyone.
Tell her congrats from me. Drinks on me next time I'm down there.
You haven't called. Your phone went to voicemail twice. Everything alright?
Call your aunt.
Mix 2 is better. Snare is less pingy
I took out about 3 dB at 900. Does the kick feel too far back
Kick feels fine, bass feels loud
That's Dev's fault, he insisted. I'll pull it down a hair
Dev is the worst
Love him
Can we book a session next week? Vocal overdubs
I've got two open evenings. The 14th or the 16th
16th. Mara can't do the 14th
16th it is, 6 pm
Running 15 min late, tell Mara to start warming up
She's already doing scales on the basement stairs
Haha that stairwell is the best reverb in town
Thanks for tonight. That harmony take at the end gave me chills
That was one take. Mara nailed it
Question about invoicing, can we split it evenly four ways
Sure. Total's the same, I'll send four small invoices
You're a saint
sorry about last night, I was a mess
Don't worry about it. You okay?
yeah, just a long week
Come eat chili. I've got six containers
Lunch? There's a taco truck by the river that's actually good
Can't today, got a mastering deadline. Next week?
Deal
Truck's back at the lot by the bridge. I'm here. Hurry
Parking. Order me the pork
Already did. Extra pickles
Ok that was a good call. Same time in two weeks
your chili cured me. Recipe?
Beans, smoked paprika, too much cumin, a square of dark chocolate
chocolate??
Trust
Dev wants to re-record the bass on song 4 because he "had a feeling"
He has a feeling every session
I told him to book his own time
Honest question. Should we put out the EP on a label or just do it ourselves
Depends if anyone's offering. Doing it yourselves is fine, nobody's retiring off an EP either way
Ha. Truth
made it. My housemate says it's better than mine
Chocolate
ok fine, chocolate wins
Hey are you around? Landed a poster designer, need the track list order
Order's in the session notes. Open the shared doc
Found it. "Salt Lick" first? Bold
It's the best opener. Trust me
Mara wants to know if you can come to the release show
Depends on timing, I'm out of town for a few days. Let me know the date
Not set yet. Venue's deciding
Poster draft is in the doc. Tell me if the band name is too big
Name's not too big. Maybe less purple
Calder, Walt. Your studio vent is humming again. Heard it from my porch
Morning Walt. I'll check the fan tonight, might be the bearing
Bring a ground wire if you open it. Saw a bare one last time
Noted
Fan was loose on its bracket. Tightened it, humming's gone
Told you. A rattle isn't a sound problem, it's a screw problem
I have a box of old XLR connectors in the garage if you want them. Went through them, some good ones
Absolutely want them. When can I come by?
Afternoon. Bring something to carry them
At your gate
Come round, I'm out back with the tomatoes
Are your bins out? Truck's early today
Just now, thanks
Saw Idris run out in socks. Good kid
Power flickered twice just now. Did you lose anything
Computer rebooted. Lost twenty minutes of a mix. Nothing big
Get yourself a UPS. The battery kind
On the list
You have a soldering iron I can borrow? Mine died
Yes, the temp-controlled one. I'll drop it off
Don't carry it by the tip
Funny
Got a box of old tubes in the garage, 12AX7s mostly. Want em?
Absolutely. I'll test them on the bench
No promises they work. Radio shop closed in '09
Returned your iron, left it on your step. Fixed the toaster too. I'm unstoppable
Got it. Was the toaster the element or the lever
Lever. They don't make them like they used to, and they never did
Came by, nobody home. Leave the box by the door?
Was at the dentist. Grabbing coffee, back in twenty
Tested the tubes. Six good, four noisy, rest dead
That's better than my batting average
Heard a loud banging down your way last night, around 11
Probably me moving a rack of gear. Sorry
Wasn't a complaint. Just checking nobody was falling down stairs
Come to dinner this weekend, Dot's making ham
Love to, what time
Six, and bring that amp schematic
Will do
Gutters are full from the storm. If you've got the ladder I'll hold it
Give me an hour. I'll come by after coffee
Good work. Pay is a tomato
Best pay I've had all month
Saw a big van outside your place early this morning. Going somewhere?
Work job for a few days. Back soon
Want me to keep an eye on the place
Appreciate it. Housemates are home, but sure
Your cat is on my fence. Grey one. Looks smug
That's Fader. He's always smug
I'll feed him a slice of ham, don't tell
He already knows. Thanks Walt
Bins go out tonight, it's the recycling one
On it.
Also, who finished the oat milk?
Not me, I'm a black coffee guy.
Wifi is down again. Is the router in your studio?
The router's in the hall. Unplug it for 30 seconds.
Back. Genius.
Did you move the cat food, I can't find it
Cupboard above the kettle. Fader is not allowed more than one scoop
He is staring at me like I owe him money
wifi's dead again, did you touch the router
Nope. Studio uplink's separate. Unplug it for ten seconds
That did it. You're a wizard
I'm a person who unplugs things
Wifi is down again, router lights are doing the thing
Pull the power for thirty seconds, then plug it back in
Back. You are a genius
going to the hardware store, need anything? lightbulbs, gaffer tape
Two black gaffer rolls if they have it, I'll pay you back
Sure
Chili in the freezer says "spicy batch". How spicy
Spicy enough that you need milk. One spoon first
They only had grey. Got one anyway
Grey's fine, thanks
Milk acquired
Can you pick up cat food on your way back? The grey bag, the sensitive stomach one
Yeah. Anything else?
Eggs. And that bread you like
Got everything. Chili's in the freezer if you're hungry, labeled
Your labels are the only reason I know what's in there. 'Chili, mild, July 14' is a love language
Quick favour: can the basement router go on the rack? Wifi in the attic is dying.
Move it up a shelf and away from the compressor. Should help.
Did it. Four bars, I feel alive 🙏
Also I made lentils. There's a bowl with your name on a sticky note.
Fader threw up on the stairs. Just a heads up, I cleaned it.
Thanks, I owe you. Dinner is on me.
Chili?
Chili.
Fine.
Bin day is tomorrow, right
Yes, recycling this time
dinner tonight? I'm making dal
Yes please. I'll do rice
deal
Wifi's down again. Did you unplug something in the basement?
Not me. Check the power strip by the router, the cat likes to chew it
Fader, you menace. Fixed it
Can I borrow your good headphones for tonight, mine broke
Top shelf in the studio. Don't use the left cup as a drink coaster
Bin day is tomorrow. You or me?
Thanks. Left them on your desk. Also there's a package by the door for you
Gus's tape. Leave it be, I'll sort it when I'm back
Hey, you free to run monitors at a wedding gig in a few weeks? Bad pay, good food
How bad is bad
150 flat, 6 hours, includes load-in
Food better be really good
Barbecue. Real barbecue
Fine. Send me the date and I'll check the calendar
Sent you the details by email. Venue is a barn off Route 288, no sound guy of their own
Does the barn have power or is it a bring-a-generator situation
Two 20 amp circuits. I checked. I'm not that cruel
Did you ever get your snake back from the church thing
Got it back yesterday, two channels dead. Gonna re-terminate the ends this week
Want my crimper?
Yes. I'll swing by tomorrow afternoon
At your door, you home?
Round back, I'm in the garage
Ha. ok
Thanks for the crimper. Also that dog is huge
She's 70 pounds of cuddle. Bring her a biscuit next time
Question: headphone amp for the band room, worth fixing or toss?
What's it doing
Left channel cuts out when you touch the knob
Dirty pot. Spray of contact cleaner, work the knob back and forth, usually fine
You're a wizard
I'm a guy with a can of contact cleaner
Rain forecast for the outdoor thing tomorrow. Do you have tarps
Two big ones and a roll of gaff tape
Bless you
That went fine. Only lost one DI box to a puddle
Which one
The cheap one. The universe takes the cheap one first
short film shoot starts soon, need a recordist for two days
Dates?
Early next month. Pays little, feeds well
Feed me and I'm yours. Send the call sheet
call sheet is in your email
Got it. Location is a church basement? Reverb will be a pain
Bring blankets
Wedding's on August 1, right? Just checking you didn't forget
Marked on the calendar. I'll bring the in-ears too
Perfect. Wear black, they're picky
Can you do a single day if the second falls through?
Maybe. Ask me again closer to it
Survived. They wanted the barn's reverb on everything, I told them barns don't do that
Barns do exactly one thing and it's flutter echo
Lol. Here's your cash, want me to drop it by or send it over?
Send it over, I'm out of the house a lot this week
Done. Check your account

I can give it four more seconds of breathing. Any more and it's just silence with ambitions
Put that on the poster
Masters are done. Final files plus a version with the loudness turned down for streaming. Invoice is on PayPal
Paid! Thank you. Also you're coming to the show, that's not optional
I'll be there if there's no live gig clash. Will let you know
hey, did you get my stems? the drive link might have expired
Got half. The last four tracks are missing
ugh, resending
should be there now
All there. Thanks. Mix draft in a couple days
I know it's a lot to ask but can the vocal sit a little more forward?
Sure, I'll push it 1 dB and see
you know I love you
We're up second on the bill. Doors at eight, we go on around nine
Got it on the calendar. Bring earplugs for your mom
Sent you a small thank you for the work, check PayPal
Got it, appreciate it
Hi, is this Low Ceiling Audio? Looking for a rate to mix a 4-song demo.
It is. $350 a song for a full mix. Send me the stems and a reference track.
Cool, will do. Need to check with the band first.
Good morning my darlings! The hydrangeas are finally out 💐
Those are gorgeous Mom. Mine are all dead. I think I drowned them
You do not water a hydrangea like a car wash, Tamsin.
Looking great, Lou. My basil is a cat bed now. Fader sits in it.
Fader sits in everything 😂
Church picnic photos are up. Reverend Banks' hat is a crime against shade.
I need that hat. For research.
Wish I could be there. Kitchen's eating my life down here.
We know, honey. Eat something that isn't from your own walk-in.
Doctor says my cholesterol is up. I blame the lemon bars and I refuse to apologize.
Mom.
Moderation, Lou. Not abstinence. Don't give up the lemon bars.
There's my sensible boy.
Look who came in with a swallowed sock this morning. He's fine!! He's SO proud of himself
Oh that face 😭
Calder you've left me on read for nine days
I've been mixing. I'll call you.
You said that last time. You say it every time.
Not doing this in the family chat.
Where else?? You don't pick up. You don't answer. This is the only place you read anything.
Boys. Please. Both of you.
No, Lou. I'm done being the only one who tries.
Calder, what did you say to him?
Nothing. That's probably the problem.
Don't let the sun go down on it, sweetheart. Whatever it is.
Fireworks at the reservoir were insane. Mom cried at the finale like always
I did not cry. Something got in my eye. A firework.
Gran's roses are putting out a second flush. Thought you'd want to see.
Calder, Rowan is your brother. Pick up the phone.
Mom he's read it, I can see the ticks
Calder. I know you're there.
I'm here. Mixing a record. I'll call you this week.
Me I get. Call him.
Not ready yet.
Ready never shows up, sweetheart. You just dial.
Fete is August 22. I have you down for the PA and two lemon bars as payment.
Is Calder alive? Asking for my mother
Alive. Sorry. Busy week. Still on for the fete.
Wear a jacket in that basement of yours, it's damp down there.
Got one. Promise.
Calder? A thumbs up at least. I haven't heard a peep since Sunday.
Text her back, she'll start mailing casseroles 😅
Do you still have my chili recipe card? The one with the grease stain
It's pinned inside the cabinet door. Grease stain intact.
Good. Don't ever clean that. The stain is the recipe.
Calder honey, did you eat today? Your cousin said you looked thin at the reunion.
I ate, Aunt Lou. Chili. Again. It's what I do on Sundays.
Chili isn't a vegetable. I'm sending you a casserole with Tamsin next time she drives down.
I won't say no to a casserole.
Good. Tuna noodle. The kind with the crunchy top.
My hip is acting up again. Doctor Fenn says it's the weather. I say it's the stairs.
Both can be true. Have you been using the cane?
The cane is in the closet where it's comfortable.
Aunt Lou. Cane. Please.
Fine. I'll take it to church tomorrow so I look respectable.
My tomatoes finally came in! More than I can eat. Do you want a bag?
Yes. I'll make sauce and freeze some. How's the squash?
The squash bugs are winning. I'm losing the war.
Soapy water on the leaves, and check under them in the morning. Tamsin showed me.
Look at you, a gardener. How is that cat?
Fader is fat and furious. Knocked a mug off the shelf this morning on purpose, I watched him do it.
Good boy. Cats should have standards.
Don't forget to call me on Sunday. I like to hear your voice and not just the typing.
I won't forget. Sunday after supper.
Love you, sweet boy. Wear a hat, it's hot out there.
Church fete: can you bring a second mic stand? Pastor wants to sing, God help us
I'll bring two. And a towel for his forehead.
Be nice. He's seventy-three and he thinks he's Sam Cooke.
Call me when you have a minute. Not about anything. Just to hear you.
Load-in at the Brass Lantern is 4pm. Soundcheck at 6, doors at 8. Please don't be late, Mo.
One time. ONE time.
Three times. I have receipts.
I'll bring the extra XLRs. Last time we were short two.
You are a hero. Also bring the stage snake if it's not fried
Snake's fine. I rewired the boot last week.
Anyone got a spare 58? Mine's got a dent big enough to lose a thumb in
I've got two in the basement. Come get one, bring coffee.
Coffee is a fair trade
Reminder the folks at the Lantern want a quieter set for the early show. Mind the low end on the kick.
Noted. I'll roll off a little under 60 on the bus.
Nerd
Proud nerd.
Who has the van on the 22nd? The fete needs a PA and a few risers
I'm doing the church fete PA myself, paid in lemon bars. I can borrow two risers if someone has a truck.
I have a truck. I want one lemon bar. That's the rate.
Calder's lemon bar economy is the only stable currency in Richmond
Spread the word: new monitor wedges came in at the Lantern, ask for the long cables before you strike
Calder, you good for Friday strike? We could use another pair of hands
Probably. I'll confirm in a day or two. Might be out of town for work.
ok favor. my friend's band needs a demo cleaned up. like three songs. can you take a look? will pay in pizza
Pizza isn't a rate but it's a start. Send the stems?
stems?? it's a phone recording in a garage
Okay. Send the garage.
sending. please be kind, the drummer is my ex
I can make a lot of things sound better. I can't make a hi-hat in a garage sound better.
lmao. do what you can
Done. Link in your email. The second song is actually good.
THEY LOVE IT. you're a wizard
Drummer says the hi-hat is 'warmer'. That's the nicest thing he's ever said to me.
Tell him it's the room. Pizza's accepted, by the way.
deal. I'll bring it to the fete. Mom's making you a lemon bar shrine
Dog vaccine clinic is slammed today. Think of me when you're eating your chili
Chili's labeled in the freezer. Fader says hi. Fader is lying, he's asleep.
Dude, my hatchback is making that noise again. The rattly one near the front wheel.
Left or right?
Right front. Gets worse over bumps.
Sway bar link, almost certainly. Twenty-dollar part, one wrench. Come over Sunday.
You are the best. I'll bring beer.
Bring the cheap beer, I'll be under the car anyway.
Fixed. Quiet as a church mouse. Your control arm bushing looks tired though.
Great, add it to the list of things that cost money.
It's a list. Mine has a whole engine on it.
Are you free Friday? Doing front-of-house at the Camel and the monitor guy bailed.
Can't, I'm on call. Ask Mo.
Mo's already in. Just wanted to see if you were around for after.
After I'm around. Text me when they're loading out.
That band had the loudest drummer alive. My ears are still ringing.
Plugs, man. You tell everybody else.
I wore them. They're the foam ones. They're like wearing a tiny pillow.
Get the filtered ones. Sixteen bucks, you can still hear the kick.
Ordered. Thanks mom.
Lol. Boiler guy came yet?
Tuesday. The pilot light's been going out every other day. Housemates are patient but not that patient.
Thermocouple, probably. Cheap fix if he's honest.
He was honest. Thirty-one dollars part, rest was his time.
See? Honest people exist. Did he check the vent?
He did. Clean as a whistle. I felt dumb for being nervous.
Not dumb. Gas is gas. Better nervous.
Want to come to the river Saturday? Idris is organizing a float with an inflatable duck.
A duck. I'm in. Sunscreen is your job.
Fine. I burn like paper anyway.
Thanks for the float. My shoulders are lobster. Your beard did not save you either.
I look like a boiled shrimp with a goatee. Fader hissed at me.
Fader has taste.
Can I borrow your tire gauge? Mine's dead.
It's in the glovebox of my truck. Spare key is under the blue pot. Take it.
Got it. Back in a sec.
Keep it. I have two.
Did you see the new place on Cary Street? Taco truck turned into a real restaurant.
Heard about it. Lunch Thursday?
Twelve-thirty. I'm buying, you're broke.
I'm frugal, not broke. But I'll take it.
Same thing. See you there.
Old Dominion Gear Swap here. Your listing for the 24-channel snake is live. A few people already asked about it.
Thanks. Is the price too high? I'd rather not haggle on it, one cut-down is bent at the end.
Looks fair for the condition. Mention the bent connector in the description so nobody complains later.
Added it. Also local pickup only, I'm not shipping thirty pounds of cable.
Understood. Buyer message coming through now, a guy in Midlothian.
I saw it. He can come by Sunday afternoon. Studio's the basement door on the side of the house.
Great. Remember to mark it sold so you stop getting pings.
Will do. Thanks for the help.
Sold, cash, no haggling. Marked it. 👍
Okay, band chat for the record. Calder, you're in. Ollie, stop adding your cousin.
He wanted to hear the demos!
Hey all. Sending the first rough of 'Slow Tide' tonight. Everything's flat, no processing, so don't panic.
Panicking in advance.
Listened. Kick is huge. Is that bad?
It's high-passed in the final. You were hearing the room in that take.
Lena's vocal is beautiful. Please don't touch it.
Stop. I'm blushing.
Can the guitars in the chorus be wider? They feel crowded.
Both guitars are panned hard. I'll pull Kit's down in level and let the second layer breathe.
Pull mine down. I'm the problem.
You are not the problem. You're a problem I'm learning to love.
New mix of Slow Tide is in the folder. Version two.
Better. Much. Bass is still shy though.
Ollie, you wrote the bass part. Of course you want it louder.
It's a fair note. I'll tuck it up a dB and watch the low end on small speakers.
Do we pick a single yet? I vote 'Paper Anchor'.
'Slow Tide' is the single. 'Paper Anchor' is the one people will cry to in the van.
Both can be singles if you stagger them. Four weeks apart, maybe.
Smart. Calder is the only one of us with a brain.
Cover art question: Kit's friend can do a risograph print. Fifty bucks for a limited run.
Risograph is perfect. Put it on the budget sheet.
Budget sheet says we have $400 left after pressing. Don't spend it all on posters.
Mastering is in the quote I sent. Don't forget it in the sheet.
Forgot. Adding now.
Mastered versions of all six are in the folder. Check them on headphones, speakers, and in the car.
Car test passed. Cried during Paper Anchor, as predicted.
Headphones test: there's a click at the end of track five.
That's the amp. I'll find it and fix it. Good ears.
Fixed version uploaded. Please listen to the last four seconds only.
Clean. Pressing plant says ten business days.
Release show at the Camel, the second Friday of next month. Doors at eight.
Do you need me on sound?
Obviously. We pay in vinyl and pizza.
Best offer all week. I'm in.
Test pressings arrived. They sound alive. Kit is hugging one.
I'm not hugging it. I'm checking for warp.
Warped?
Flat as a pancake. Noise floor is lovely.
Great. Soundcheck is at five, bring your own cables this time, Ollie.
Calder! It's Hannah. Aunt Lou gave me your number at the reunion. Hope that's okay.
Hannah Greer? Hi! Of course it's okay. Been years.
Since your cousin's graduation party. I have a favor and a bribe.
Start with the bribe.
Homemade pimento cheese for life.
Okay, I'm listening.
We cleaned out my dad's garage and found a box of reel-to-reel tapes. Labels in his handwriting. I'd love to hear what's on them.
That's right up my alley. Bring them by the studio and I'll check what condition they're in.
Studio is the basement at your place?
Yep. Low ceiling, hence the name. Mind your head on the pipe.
Dropping by Saturday around two with the box. Is that okay?
Two works. Don't leave them in a hot car, please.
Hot car?? I'm learning so much.
Thank you for the tour. The cat is wonderful. The ceiling is deadly.
Fader approves of you. He doesn't approve of anyone. Four of the reels are playable.
Only four? There were twelve.
The rest need baking first. I'm borrowing a dehydrator from a friend. Might be able to save most.
Bake the tapes. Like cookies?
Basically. Low and slow, to bind the oxide back on.
Calder. I listened to the four. It's my dad singing 'Moon River' to my mom in the kitchen. I had to sit on the floor.
I know. I hesitated before I sent it. I'm glad you got it.
Please don't charge me less than you should. I want to pay you properly.
Family rate. Forty an hour, cleaned and tagged, and I won't bill the baking.
That's too low and you know it. Fifty and I won't argue.
Fine. Fifty. You drive a hard bargain.
Pimento cheese on its way Thursday. Mind the jar, it's glass.
Got it. Ate half on a cracker standing at the counter. Not sorry.
Good. Any luck with the tapes in the baking batch?
Six more survived. Two are just hiss. One's your mom reading a recipe, half in jest.
Banana bread. It's gotta be the banana bread. She wrote it down on a napkin in the end.
It's banana bread. She says 'a heaping cup, not a level one'.
That's her. That's exactly her.
I'm putting everything on a drive with a track list. Want a spare copy for your sister too?
Yes please. She'll cry louder than I did.
Two drives it is. I'll label them by hand, no stickers.
Picked up from your housemate. She was lovely. What's her name again?
That's Joss. Night nurse, sleeps in the day, so you caught her lucky.
Tell her the pimento cheese is on me if she wants one.
She'll fight Idris for it. Thank you, Hannah.
Thank YOU. Come to Charlottesville sometime. I'll feed you.
Welcome to the editing group! Calder, this is Nadia, my co-host, and Tess, our producer.
Hi all. Happy to be on board. Send raw files whenever, I'll turn them in forty-eight hours.
We're recording episode twelve tonight. It's a long one, sorry in advance.
How long is long?
Ninety minutes raw. We'll cut it to forty-five. Probably.
Files are in the folder. Lots of laughing, some coughing, one dog.
Got them. The dog's a star, I'll keep a little. The cough at minute twenty I'll lose.
That was Nadia's cough, she was dying.
I was NOT dying. It was a tickle.
First cut is up. Marked the sections I wasn't sure about with a red tag.
Reviewed. The second red tag is a real moment, keep it. The first one, cut.
Agree with Tess. Also can the intro music duck a little lower under our voices?
Easy. I'll automate it so it dips as soon as you start talking.
Final of ep twelve is live! Thank you, Calder.
Listened on the bus. Sounds way better than our 'professional' setup.
Your room is the issue. Hang a moving blanket behind you and it'll get another notch better.
A moving blanket. Like from a moving van?
Exactly. Hardware stores sell them for twenty bucks. Cheapest acoustic treatment there is.
Ordered two. Will report.
Episode thirteen raw is in. Guest this time, so two mics shared. Sorry.
Shared mic is rough but doable. I'll gate gently and balance the levels.
The guest is a baker. She talks about sourdough for forty minutes.
I'm cutting at the point where the starter gets a name. After that it's just lore.
Her starter is named Gerald. Please keep Gerald.
Gerald stays.
Invoice question: is that per episode or per hour?
Per episode, flat. Easier to budget. Sent through PayPal, same as before.
Paid. Does PayPal mark it as goods or friends? I never remember.
Goods and services is fine. Thanks Tess.
We're taking a break in July. Nadia has a wedding and I have a root canal.
Wedding AND root canal. Which one first?
Root canal. Wedding's the reward.
Back in the studio. Here's episode fourteen. It's short, I swear.
Short is a gift. Turnaround tomorrow evening.
Did the moving blankets help?
MASSIVELY. The echo's gone. I sound like a real person.
You sounded like a real person before. Now you sound like a real person with good taste.
Aww.
Fourteen is up. Credits at the end have a typo, I'll fix it, no extra charge.
What typo?? Oh no. Is it my name?
Got your voicemail. Yeah, I've got six reels of 456 left, ten and a half inch, all sealed.
Nice. What are you asking per reel?
Forty a pop. Forty-five if I ship. Pickup's free, I'm in Scott's Addition till five.
I'll swing by Thursday. Can I take four?
Four's fine. I'll set them behind the register with your name on the box.
Got them. One box has a dented flange but the tape's fine. Thanks Gus.
Dent's from the move. Knock a few bucks off next time, I'll remember.
Hey, you still got that splicing block with the razor channel?
The Edit-All? Yeah. It's got a little rust on the groove but it works. $25.
Hold it for me till the weekend?
Held. Bring cash, my card reader hates me.
Picked it up. Rust came off with a pencil eraser. Good as new.
Old trick. Don't use steel wool, it magnetizes the thing.
Noted. Demagnetizer's still on my list.
I've got one on a shelf I never use. Hand-held, works fine. Take it.
Seriously? Gus, you're a saint.
Not a saint, I just hate clutter. Come get it before I change my mind.
Question. Client sent me a reel that's shedding oxide all over the heads. Bake it?
What brand and what year?
Scotch, early seventies by the box. Sticky shed, I think.
Sounds like it. Bake it, low and slow. Hundred and thirty degrees, about six hours, in a food dehydrator if you've got one.
I don't have a dehydrator. Would my housemate's toaster oven do?
Please don't. Toaster ovens swing forty degrees either way. You'll make spaghetti. Borrow mine.
Okay, I'll borrow yours. Sunday?
Sunday's fine. Bring a thermometer so you trust it.
Baked it. Played it once clean and transferred the whole thing. Thank you.
Once clean is the rule. Don't play it twice. Print it to disk and put the reel away.
Already in the archive. Two copies, two drives.
Good man. Third copy somewhere that isn't your house.
Fair point. I'll put a drive in Aunt Lou's closet.
Ha. Best archive in Virginia, behind the Christmas tree.
Got a lot of quarter-inch coming in from an estate sale in Ashland. Want first look?
Always. What's on them?
Boxes marked 'church picnic', 'Ruth's piano', that kind of thing. Dozens of them.
Those are the good ones. I'll take whatever's playable.
I'll sort them tomorrow. Bring the big tote bag.
Sorted. Eleven are yours, the rest are mold or blank. $60 for the lot.
Deal. Can I come Saturday morning?
I'll be in from eight. Coffee's on me.
Perfect. See you then.
Good evening everyone. Brother Calder has agreed to record the choir for the anniversary album. Let's use this group for scheduling.
Happy to help. I'll need the sanctuary quiet, no AC running during takes, and about two hours for setup.
The AC makes a racket. I'll ask the trustees about switching it off during sessions.
First rehearsal-recording is Saturday at ten. Sopranos please arrive early, we'll warm up on the stairs.
Do we wear robes?
No robes, it's audio. Wear comfortable shoes, though. Nobody tap their feet on the risers.
Noted. I will personally monitor the feet.
Parking is behind the fellowship hall. Please leave the front lot for the van.
What van?
The church van. Brother Wallace is driving the elders to the retreat that morning.
Got it. I'll load in the back door, it's closer to the outlet by the piano anyway.
Pastor wants me to remind everyone: no coffee near the piano.
Also please no jewelry that jingles. Bracelets are the worst.
Bracelets, noted. Sister Odessa, that means you.
Good session today. The altos on 'Wade in the Water' gave me chills. Mixes by next weekend.
The Lord was in that room. Thank you for your patience with us.
Can we do another pass on the second verse of 'Hold On'? I came in early.
You came in right on the money, Mina. The tenors were a hair late. I can nudge it in editing.
Tenors, a hair late. I'll tell them.
Rough mixes are in the shared folder. Please listen on decent speakers, not phone speakers.
Listened in the car. My wife cried at the bridge of 'Hold On'.
Could the piano be a little louder in 'Wade'? It sounds far away.
Sure, I'll bring it up and send a new version. The mic was a few feet back to catch the room.
Is there a way to take out the baby noise at the beginning of track four?
That's the Whitfield baby, and we're keeping it. Everybody loves it.
It's only half a second. I'll fade it down a touch, you won't lose the charm.
Reminder: Sunday service this week begins at half past ten, not nine. Summer schedule.
Fourth of July cookout is at the fellowship hall after service on Sunday. Bring a dish.
I'll bring a pan of my chili. Labelled, with beans listed, for the allergy folks.
A man after my own heart. Labeled food is a ministry.
Final mixes are ready. Master files go on the drive for the printer, and I'll make a streaming version too.
The printer needs the track titles spelled exactly. Mina has the list.
Sending it now. Please nobody change the order again.
Order is final, I promise. Ask me again and I'll make you sing it twice.
Invoice is in your email, Reverend. No rush. Net thirty is fine.
The treasurer has it. She says the check goes out Friday.
Check arrived. Thank you all, truly. Best room I've worked in this year.
We'll have you back for the Christmas program, if you can stand us.
Christmas program I would not miss. Mark me in.
God bless you, Calder. Eat something besides chili.
Reminder: street cleanup this Saturday, 9 AM. Bring gloves and trash bags. City is dropping off a dumpster by the corner.
I'll bring the wheelbarrow and my leaf blower. Anyone got a long-handled grabber?
I've got two. Pretty sure one of them is from Marlow Hardware's clearance bin.
Perfect. Calder, can you do the storm drain by the corner? The one that floods.
Sure, I'll take it. Might be late, I've got a session until 8 the night before.
No stress. Coffee and donuts at the end, Dwight's wife is baking.
Apple cinnamon. Don't tell the others, there's only two dozen.
Drain's clear. Pulled out about a pound of leaves and one very sad flip-flop.
Calder! Found a stack of old 45s at the estate sale on Cary Street. Want first look before I list them?
Always. Any soul or gospel stuff in there? I need clean snare samples for a project.
Plenty of gospel, a few Stax. Some are chewed up though. Dust jackets are gorgeous.
I'll take whatever's playable. What do you want for the lot?
$40 and you buy me a coffee at Kestrel. Deal?
Deal. Saturday morning, I'll bring cash. I'm frugal, not a monster.
Ha. Bring a tote bag, they're heavy.
Those snares are perfect btw. Dry as a bone. You're a hero.
yo Calder, you free to run sound for the Friday set at the Brass Lantern? Our guy bailed
Depends. What's the lineup and how many channels? Last time the monitors were a disaster.
Two bands, one acoustic opener. Maybe 14 channels total. They said they fixed the wedges.
I'll believe it when I hear it. $150 flat, load-in at 5, and someone else carries the subs.
Deal. I'll carry the subs, my back is fine. 😂
Bring your own XLRs, theirs are all crackly.
Great night. Crowd actually stayed for the opener. Cash is in an envelope behind the bar, ask for Pat.
Got it, thanks. Next time tell Pat the bass amp does not go on the stool.
Hi Calder, this is Ferrell Heating. Got your message about the basement boiler making a knocking sound.
Yeah, it started after the last cold snap. Bangs for a minute when it kicks on, then settles. Pressure gauge sits a bit low too.
Sounds like air in the loop or a tired circulator. We can bleed it and check the pump. Thursday between 1 and 3 work?
Thursday works. I'll be in the studio downstairs, just knock. Fair warning, the ceiling is low, mind your head.
Ha, noted. Service call is $95, parts extra. I'll text before I swap anything.
Fine by me.
All done. Bled the loop, pump is fine, pressure back to 12 psi. If the knocking comes back call us and we'll look at the expansion tank.
Quiet as a church down here now. Thanks, I'll send the invoice payment through tonight.

notes.title: Boiler: pilot relight steps
notes.body:
From the Ferrell guy + that forum thread:

1. Knob to OFF, wait 5 min (smell for gas first)
2. Knob to PILOT, hold it down
3. Click the igniter till it catches, keep holding 60 sec
4. Release slowly. If it dies, repeat once, then stop
5. Knob to ON, thermostat up

If it won't hold twice = thermocouple, not me. Call Ferrell.
Basement door sticks, lift while you push.
